# A PUT that overwrites an entry with another UID: 409 no-uid-conflict
# (RFC 4791 5.3.2.1, RFC 6352 6.3.2.1) naming the entry, content unchanged.
@seed calendar privat termin.ics dentist.ics
@seed contacts kontakte erika.vcf erika.vcf

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/termin.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-Match: {etag:dentist.ics}
> Body: weekly-team.ics
< status 409
< error cal:no-uid-conflict
< body-has <d:href>/caldav/alex/calendars/privat/termin.ics</d:href>

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/termin.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< body dentist.ics
< header ETag {etag:dentist.ics}

# The same UID is an ordinary edit.
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/termin.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-Match: {etag:dentist.ics}
> Body: dentist-moved.ics
< status 204
< header ETag {etag:dentist-moved.ics}

> PUT /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/erika.vcf
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/vcard
> Body: group-family.vcf
< status 409
< error card:no-uid-conflict
< body-has <d:href>/carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/erika.vcf</d:href>

> GET /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/erika.vcf
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< body erika.vcf
